The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] established a '''temple''' in a moist lowland on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==History==
According to legend, several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] visited Caamas in an attempt to learn "proper moral judgement." Later, the Jedi established a temple on the planet, which they used for contemplation. After the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the temple was abandoned and was later destroyed by the [[Caamas Firestorm]]. Only a few rooms survived.<ref name="CatCW" />
